jobs.title: Head of Data Systems (Google Stack)
jobs.description:
The Head of Data Systems (Google Stack) will play a key role at Stacktics, required to help create and maintain industry-leading quality and efficiency of service and software delivery.

Stacktics will rely on the Head of Data Systems with ownership of the Data Systems function including mentoring and support for our team of engineers, developers, marketing analysts and data scientists. The successful candidate will be expected to meet and exceed Stacktics' quality standards, while helping the organization rapidly expand into increasingly complex application development, data engineering, and related workflows.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ownership of Stacktics' Data Systems Business Unit

Build and grow your team's capabilities and expertise to be truly platform-agnostic, ever-adapting based on opportunity and business direction
Lead thorough audits of clients'/prospects' Data Systems, and other associated platforms and technologies as applicable including performance and cloud cost-efficiency
Provide proactive recommendations, identifying areas of opportunity and/or improvement for clients based on their underlying business objectives and goals
Maintain continuous focus on work output quality and reliability, acting as the champion of customer satisfaction in a proactive manner and as the final escalation point for technical and delivery issues that cannot be resolved at the Technical Lead level
Act as Stacktics' primary Data Systems expert, ensuring to maintain and continuously grow personal expertise, and sharing information with other Stacktics team members, client stakeholders and prospects
Collaborate with, support, and work closely with cross-functional units to ensure efficient workflow, and realize cross-functional opportunities and enhancements
Maintain responsibility for the Business Unit's growth and success, continuously developing existing engagements, optimizing resourcing and prospecting
Be dedicated to the success and happiness of your team members, optimizing workflow, enabling their personal growth, and acting as a strong team leader overall

Instilling Development Best Practices and Skills/Procedures Advancement

Establishing, maintaining and evolving DevSecOps best practices and tools, and continuously keeping them aligned with current industry best practices and procedures
Understanding, implementing and automating security controls, governance processes, and compliance validation frameworks
Contributing to deployment tooling within the Stacktics team
Contributing to version control technology frameworks and creating/implementing working processes within the Data Systems team, with tools such as Git or SVN
Own and continuously improve the practice's AI coding standards, the AI coding constitution (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules), PR checklists, and slash commands keeping them current as tools, clients, and the team's needs evolve

Leading in the Software 3.0 Era

AI tools have changed how fast engineering work gets produced. Your job is to make sure that speed shows up as sounder architecture and higher-quality delivery — not just faster shipping of the same judgment gaps.
Recalibrate how the team scopes and estimates work as AI tooling changes what can actually be delivered in a sprint, so timelines and resourcing plans reflect real AI-era delivery speed
Set architecture and coding standards that assume engineers are using AI assistants daily — code review habits, eval frameworks, and quality gates sized to the failure modes of AI-assisted development, not just its speed
Continue evolving Stacktics' AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC) — our AI-native answer to SDLC — piloting new stages against real engagements and driving adoption across the team
Be an active daily user of AI coding assistants yourself, and bring that firsthand experience into how standards and review practices are set for the team
Lead Stacktics’ technical team members through the integration into Agentic AI-first working patterns, and beyond

Code Productization

Migrating the delivery of the most common/universally applicable solutions from custom projects to formally productized software solutions
Advocating for building repeatability, scalability and standardization into how the Stacktics Data Systems team approaches all work, in order to enable the future migration to productization as a general rule

Data Engineering-Specific Responsibilities

Participate in continuous delivery pipelines to fully automate deployment of the highly available cloud platform that supports multiple projects
Design and develop ETL workflows and datasets to be used in data visualization tools
Write complex SQL queries with multiple joins to automate and manipulate data extracts
Perform end to end Data Validation to maintain accuracy of data sets
Build tools for deployment, monitoring and operations
Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the development, test and production environments
Develop re-usable processes that can be leveraged and standardized for multiple instances
Prepare technical specifications and documentation for projects
Stay up to date on relevant technologies, plug into user groups, understand trends and opportunities to ensure we are using the best possible techniques and tools
Understand, implement, and automate security controls, governance processes, and compliance validation

Contribution to Corporate Strategy

Actively and proactively play a key role in steering Stacktics and affiliated companies, considering market developments, competitive maneuvers, unique opportunities, etc.
You will be expected to both bring new ideas to the table and assist other corporate leaders in vetting/developing concepts and tactics
Identification and tracking of performance, coaching, training needs, and motivating members of the Data Systems team — including Senior Technical Leads. Directly or indirectly responsible for hiring, terminating and owning performance evaluations for direct reports and the Data Systems group

Company-Wide Responsibilities

Maintain and exceed client satisfaction with Stacktics’ deliverables, day-to-day work and overall value as a partner
Adapt to ever-changing client needs and expectations
Maintain dedication toward achieving excellence in Stacktics’ delivery against client needs, and overall success as an organization
Ability to provide clear guidance and support for advanced problem solving and system design to large teams at enterprise-level client companies, aiding the evolution of their digital practices

QUALIFICATIONS

Deep expertise in building and managing large-scale data systems on cloud platforms, with a strong preference for Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services
Python, SQL and Cloud Computing
10+ years experience in Data Engineering, including 6+ years in technical leadership or management roles, with experience managing other leads (e.g., Technical Leads or engineering managers).
Strong understanding of and direct experience with managing a team operating in a “Software 3.0” model (Agentic AI-first)
Active user of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent), and fluent in what they change about estimation, architecture, and review
Understanding of digital ecosystems including online data collection, cloud systems and analytics tools (Google Stack, Facebook, Salesforce, Adobe Suite etc.) a strong asset
Strong technical understanding of a range of marketing concepts such as cookie-based data collection, setting and leveraging audience segments, attribution modelling, AB/N & multivariate is an asset
Excellent written & verbal communication skills are essential; candidate should be comfortable presenting and participating in group discussions of concepts with internal and external stakeholders
Candidate must exhibit an analytical, detail-oriented approach to problem solving
Experience with Jira / Atlassian project management tools is an asset

Preferred Qualifications

Google Cloud certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer) are a strong plus.
Prior experience in a consulting environment, managing and delivering projects for multiple clients concurrently.

jobs.title: Director – Data, Analytics & AI (BFSI)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an accomplished Data & Analytics Leader
to drive enterprise-wide Data, Analytics, and AI transformation initiatives within the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sector.

This is a strategic leadership position combining technology consulting, enterprise transformation, business development, and client engagement. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in shaping data-led business strategies, building executive relationships, developing strategic opportunities, and delivering measurable business outcomes.
You will work closely with CDOs, CIOs, CAIOs, and senior business stakeholders to define transformation strategies, accelerate AI adoption, and drive business growth.

Key Responsibilities
1. Strategic Leadership & Client Advisory

Build trusted relationships with CDOs, CIOs, CAIOs, and senior business executives.
Advise BFSI clients on enterprise data strategy, analytics transformation, AI adoption, and data modernization.
Lead executive workshops, strategic discussions, and transformation planning sessions.
Translate business challenges into actionable roadmaps and measurable business outcomes.

2. Business Development & Growth

Drive business growth across Data, Analytics, and AI consulting services.
Identify, qualify, and develop strategic opportunities from initial engagement through proposal and closure.
Lead RFP responses, solution development, commercial discussions, and executive presentations.
Build strategic partnerships with technology providers, alliance partners, and consulting practices.
Develop reference customers and establish long-term strategic client relationships.

3. Enterprise Data, Analytics & AI Transformation

Define enterprise data strategies, target architectures, operating models, and governance frameworks.
Drive modernization initiatives across cloud data platforms, data engineering, analytics, and AI.
Guide the adoption of AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, and Responsible AI.
Champion modern data platforms, data products, self-service analytics, and decision intelligence.
Ensure solutions meet enterprise requirements for scalability, security, regulatory compliance, and cost optimization.

4. Program & People Leadership

Provide executive oversight across large-scale consulting and transformation engagements.
Establish governance frameworks covering delivery milestones, risks, dependencies, quality, and business outcomes.
Lead and mentor cross-functional teams across consulting, architecture, engineering, analytics, and AI.
Develop reusable frameworks, reference architectures, consulting offerings, and delivery playbooks.
Support leadership development, talent acquisition, succession planning, and capability building.

Required Qualifications & Experience

18+ years of professional experience across Data, Analytics, AI, Technology Consulting, and Enterprise Transformation.
Extensive expertise in Enterprise Data Strategy, Data Architecture, Data Governance, Data Products, and Data Modernization.
Strong understanding of the end-to-end data value chain, including data engineering, integration, ETL/ELT, APIs, DataOps, and platform engineering.
Proven experience leading enterprise Analytics and Business Intelligence initiatives.
Strong knowledge of AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, MLOps/LLMOps, and Responsible AI.
Experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale solutions using Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, and modern data platforms.
Strong understanding of BFSI industry requirements, including regulatory compliance, data privacy, security, risk management, and auditability.
Demonstrated success in consulting, business development, pre-sales, solution architecture, opportunity management, and commercial negotiations.
Experience managing large transformation programs and engaging with C-suite executives.
Proven ability to lead geographically distributed, cross-functional teams.

Education & Certifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Data, or a related discipline.
Master's degree or MBA preferred.
Relevant certifications in Cloud, Enterprise Architecture, Data Management, Analytics, AI, Program Management, or Executive Leadership are advantageous.

Leadership Competencies
Executive stakeholder management and relationship building.
Strategic thinking and business development.
Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills.
Strong commercial and business acumen.
Enterprise transformation and program governance.
Team leadership, mentoring, and capability development.
High ownership, accountability, and commitment to client success.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Director

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting

jobs.title: Director, Product Strategy & Growth-- KUMDC6173915
jobs.description:
Role purpose

The Director, Product Strategy & Growth is accountable for the strategic direction, growth, profitability, and lifecycle management of an assigned product portfolio. The role translates customer, market and business insight into a focused portfolio strategy, investment roadmap and commercialization plan that strengthen market position and deliver measurable value for customers, distribution partners, and the business. As a senior product leader and people leader, the Director brings together teams across Product, Distribution, Marketing, Digital, Technology, Operations, Finance, Legal, Risk and Compliance to make sound portfolio choices, accelerate execution and ensure products remain relevant, sustainable, and differentiated.

Key accountabilities:

Strategy and portfolio ownership:

Own and continuously refine the long-term strategy, value proposition and investment roadmap for the assigned portfolio, aligned to enterprise and business priorities.
Manage the full product lifecycle, including ideation, validation, development, launch, optimization, modernization, rationalization and, where required, responsible exit or run-off.
Maintain a focused and relevant product shelf that supports growth, client retention, member value, operational sustainability, and market differentiation.
Translate strategic priorities into clear choices, sequenced roadmaps, investment recommendations, and measurable outcomes.
Structure complex or ambiguous business opportunities into evidence-based assessments and business cases that clearly articulate customer and business value, financial implications, operational impacts, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs.

Customer, market, and competitive insights:

Champion the voice of the customer by incorporating sponsor, member, advisor and distribution insights into product strategy, design, and prioritization.
Use customer research, market intelligence, competitive analysis, emerging trends, and performance data to identify unmet needs, growth opportunities, and portfolio risks.
Define the customer and business problems to be solved and ensure product decisions are grounded in evidence, clear hypotheses, and expected outcomes.
Monitor developments in technology, regulation, healthcare, benefits, and adjacent markets to anticipate changes that may affect the portfolio.

Growth, commercialization, and performance:

Lead commercialization and go-to-market strategies that strengthen positioning, enable distribution, and improve adoption, engagement, revenue, and profitability.
Partner with Sales, Marketing and Distribution to develop compelling value propositions, sales narratives, launch plans and client-facing materials.
Establish and regularly review portfolio scorecards covering customer outcomes, adoption, growth, revenue, profitability, operational health, risk, and strategic value, with clear accountability for delivering agreed portfolio outcomes
Use performance insights to recommend investment, optimization, pricing, remediation or exit decisions and communicate progress to senior leadership.

Product and delivery leadership:

Lead major product initiatives from opportunity assessment and business case through delivery, launch and benefits realization.
Set strategic priorities and desired outcomes for cross-functional delivery teams, ensuring resources remain focused on the highest-value opportunities.
Guide discovery, experimentation and validation using customer research, concept testing, analytics, and other fit for-purpose methods before significant investment is made.
Partner with Digital, Technology, Design and Operations leaders to create integrated experiences and scalable solutions; provide direction on scope and minimum viable product decisions.
Identify and evaluate opportunities to use AI, automation, data, and emerging digital capabilities to improve customer value, operating effectiveness, or business performance.
Lead the strategic management of external product partners and vendors, working with Procurement and business partners on selection, contracting, renewals, service expectations, performance, and ongoing strategic alignment.
Ensure product launches and material changes are operationally ready, with appropriate contracts, policy provisions, processes, training, communications, controls, and distribution enablement in place.

Risk, governance and regulatory stewardship:

Own product governance for the assigned portfolio and ensure material product, customer, contractual, operational, financial, and regulatory risks are understood and managed.
Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Privacy, and other control functions to obtain required approvals and ensure products and communications meet applicable requirements.
Bring forward clear decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations when risk, customer value, economics, or delivery feasibility are in tension.
Maintain appropriate documentation, controls, decision records, and escalation paths across the product lifecycle.

Enterprise leadership and talent development:

Build strong relationships and influence across functions and levels to align stakeholders, resolve ambiguity, and move complex decisions forward.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team, setting clear expectations and building strength in strategic thinking, commercial acumen, customer insight, and execution.
Create an inclusive, accountable, and learning-oriented team environment that encourages constructive challenge and sound decision-making.
Represent the portfolio in senior leadership discussions, capabilities presentations, distribution forums, client meetings, advisory boards, and industry events as required.
Lead strategic initiatives spanning the broader product organization or business where enterprise priorities require cross-portfolio leadership.

Measures of success:

Clear portfolio strategy and roadmap with demonstrated alignment to business priorities.
Measurable improvement in customer value, adoption, growth, profitability, retention, and/or strategic differentiation, as appropriate to the portfolio.
Disciplined investment choices supported by evidence, transparent trade-offs, and defined success measures.
Reliable delivery of priority initiatives, with effective management of scope, dependencies, risks, and benefits realization.
Strong product governance, partner performance, and lifecycle management.
An engaged, capable team with clear accountability and succession depth.

Qualifications and experience:

Required:

Undergraduate degree in business, finance, marketing, health, technology or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Typically, 8+ years of progressive product, strategy, innovation, or commercialization, including leadership of complex cross-functional initiatives.
Demonstrated experience in financial services, insurance, group benefits, health, wellbeing, disability, or other regulated industries.
Demonstrated experience developing product or portfolio strategies and translating them into executable roadmaps, business cases, and measurable outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to apply product and strategic capabilities across different portfolios, quickly build subject matter expertise and lead effectively as business priorities evolve.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience assessing product economics, investment tradeoffs, and portfolio performance.
Proven ability to lead through influence in a highly matrixed and regulated environment.
Experience leading, coaching, and developing people and building effective teams.
Excellent executive communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex issues, frame decisions and deliver clear recommendations.

Preferred:

Experience in group benefits, health, wellbeing, dental and/or disability products, including employer-sponsored solutions.
Experience managing strategic partnerships, vendors, or ecosystem-based propositions.
Experience with digital product development, customer experience design, agile delivery, and data-informed experimentation.
Working knowledge of relevant compliance, privacy, risk, and product governance practices.

Leadership capabilities:

Strategic and enterprise thinking:
Connects market, customer, and business signals; makes choices that strengthen long-term enterprise value.
Customer and growth orientation:
Balances customer outcomes with commercial discipline and sustainable portfolio growth.
Decision quality:
Uses evidence, judgment, and clear trade-offs to make timely recommendations in ambiguous situations.
Influence and collaboration:
Builds alignment across diverse stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority.
Execution and accountability:
Turns strategy into priorities, mobilizes teams, and follows through on measurable outcomes.
Innovation and adaptability:
Challenges established approaches, learns quickly and responds effectively to changing conditions.
People leadership:
Sets a clear direction, coaches for growth, and creates an inclusive, high-performance environment.
Technology and data fluency:
Uses technology, analytics, and emerging capabilities to improve products, experiences, and decisions.

Decision authority:

Full people and resource management accountability within the assigned team, in accordance with organizational policies and delegated authority.
Recommend portfolio strategy, investment priorities, product launches, significant enhancements, remediation, rationalization and exit decisions to senior leadership.
Prioritize and reprioritize portfolio work based on customer value, strategic alignment, economics, capacity, risk, and changing business needs.
Define desired outcomes, minimum viable product parameters, and scope guardrails for assigned initiatives.
Direct minor product enhancements and lifecycle actions within approved strategy, budget, risk appetite, and governance requirements.
Manage approved budgets, business cases, financial commitments, and partner performance for the assigned portfolio.
Make implementation and operating decisions within delegated authority and escalate material issues, risks, or trade-offs as required.
Own product risk and governance decisions within the assigned portfolio, in partnership with the appropriate control functions.

Working conditions:

Hybrid work arrangements and office location are subject to business and organizational requirements.
Travel may be required for internal events, client meetings, partner engagements, advisory boards, and industry conferences.

Our commitment to inclusion:

We embrace our diversity. We strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that is as diverse as the customers we serve and to foster an inclusive work environment that embraces the strength of cultures and individuals. We are committed to fair recruitment, retention, advancement and compensation, and we administer all of our practices and programs without discrimination on the basis of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, religion or religious beliefs, creed, sex (including pregnancy and pregnancy-related conditions), sexual orientation, genetic characteristics, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, or any other ground protected by applicable law.

1. Role Overview

Lead the Product Management team responsible initially for Disability and Dental products.
Portfolio may expand to include Life, Health, and Voluntary Benefits.
Focus on product transformation, optimization, growth, and new product launches.

Looking for an experienced operator who can lead a team, bring fresh perspectives, and drive portfolio transformation.
Manager prefers competencies and likability over key skills; there is scope to learn but they should be able to quickly build rapport
